title: Classroom Safety Risk Assessment
description: Free Classroom Safety Risk Assessment template for education you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers classroom information, classroom hazard identification and risk assessment, classroom inspection checklist.

Classroom Inspection Checklist

FURNITURE & EQUIPMENT:

☐ All bookshelves and cabinets secured to wall (anti-tip devices installed)

☐ No sharp edges/protrusions that could cause injury

☐ Chairs and desks in good repair (no broken parts)

☐ Furniture arranged to allow clear pathways (minimum 36" wide)

☐ Storage areas organized (no items stacked dangerously)

☐ Teacher's desk area clear of clutter

☐ Computer equipment properly secured and ventilated

ELECTRICAL SAFETY:

☐ All electrical cords in good condition (no fraying, exposed wires)

☐ Cords not run under rugs or through doorways

☐ Outlets not overloaded (power strips with circuit breakers used)

☐ Outlet covers in place in younger grade classrooms

☐ No extension cords used as permanent wiring

☐ GFCI protection in place near sinks/water sources

☐ All electronics have UL listing label

FIRE SAFETY:

☐ Exit paths clear and unobstructed

☐ Fire extinguisher accessible and within inspection date

☐ Smoke detector functioning (tested within 30 days)

☐ No combustibles stored near heat sources

☐ Fire evacuation route posted

☐ Students aware of fire drill procedures

☐ Door can be opened from inside without key

WINDOW & BLIND SAFETY:

☐ Window stops/guards installed on upper floor windows

☐ Windows in good repair (no broken glass, operable properly)

☐ Blind cords have tensioners or are cordless

☐ No furniture placed near windows that could allow climbing

☐ Emergency exit windows clearly marked and unobstructed

FLOORING & WALKWAYS:

☐ Floors clean and dry (no spills)

☐ Rugs have non-slip backing or are secured

☐ No tripping hazards (uneven flooring, mats with curled edges)

☐ Aisles between desks at least 24" wide

☐ Pathway to exit at least 36" wide

☐ Thresholds level and in good condition

CHEMICAL & SUPPLY STORAGE:

☐ All cleaning supplies stored in locked cabinet

☐ Art supplies (paints, solvents) in locked storage

☐ All containers properly labeled

☐ SDS binder accessible and up to date

☐ No food stored with chemicals

☐ Ventilation adequate for any chemical use

EMERGENCY PREPAREDNESS:

☐ Emergency procedures posted

☐ Class roster and emergency contacts readily available

☐ Emergency kit/backpack stocked and accessible

☐ Students with medical conditions identified (privacy maintained)

☐ Communication plan with office established

☐ Flashlight available and working

☐ First aid kit stocked and accessible

SPECIAL NEEDS ACCOMMODATIONS:

☐ Accessible pathways for students with mobility devices

☐ Desk/workspace appropriate for students with physical disabilities

☐ Visual fire alarms for hearing impaired (if applicable)

☐ Evacuation plan includes students with disabilities

☐ Emergency supplies for students with specific medical needs
